segments.ja506:1.1: Kā nu vijjurivābhāsi, osadhī viya tārakā;
segments.ja506:1.3: Devatā nusi gandhabbī, na taṃ maññāmi mānusiṃ [mānusī (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja506:2.1: Namhi devī na gandhabbī, na mahārāja mānusī;
segments.ja506:3.1: Vibbhantacittā kupitindriyāsi, nettehi te vārigaṇā savanti;
segments.ja506:3.3: Kiṃ te naṭṭhaṃ kiṃ pana patthayānā, idhāgatā nāri tadiṅgha brūhi.
segments.ja506:4.1: Yamuggatejo uragoti cāhu, nāgoti naṃ āhu janā janinda;
segments.ja506:4.3: Tamaggahī puriso jīvikattho, taṃ bandhanā muñca patī mameso.
segments.ja506:5.1: Kathaṃ nvayaṃ balaviriyūpapanno, hatthatta [hatthattha (sī. syā. pī.)] māgacchi vanibbakassa;
segments.ja506:5.3: Akkhāhi me nāgakaññe tamatthaṃ, kathaṃ vijānemu gahītanāgaṃ.
segments.ja506:6.1: Nagarampi nāgo bhasmaṃ kareyya, tathā hi so balaviriyūpapanno;
segments.ja506:6.3: Dhammañca nāgo apacāyamāno, tasmā parakkamma tapo karoti.
segments.ja506:7.1: Cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ [pannarasiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] ca rāja, catuppathe sammati nāgarājā;
segments.ja506:7.3: Tamaggahī puriso jīvikattho, taṃ bandhanā muñca patī mameso.
segments.ja506:8.3: Vārigehasayā nārī [nāriyo (pī.)], tāpi taṃ saraṇaṃ gatā.
segments.ja506:9.1: Dhammena mocehi asāhasena, gāmena nikkhena gavaṃ satena;
segments.ja506:9.3: Ossaṭṭhakāyo urago carātu, puññatthiko muñcatu bandhanasmā.
segments.ja506:10.1: Dhammena mocemi asāhasena, gāmena nikkhena gavaṃ satena;
segments.ja506:10.3: Ossaṭṭhakāyo urago carātu, puññatthiko muñcatu bandhanasmā.
segments.ja506:12.1: Dve ca sādisiyo bhariyā, usabhañca gavaṃ sataṃ;
segments.ja506:12.3: Ossaṭṭhakāyo urago carātu, puññatthiko muñcatu bandhanasmā.
segments.ja506:13.1: Vināpi dānā tava vacanaṃ janinda, muñcemu naṃ uragaṃ bandhanasmā;
segments.ja506:13.3: Ossaṭṭhakāyo urago carātu, puññatthiko muñcatu bandhanasmā.
segments.ja506:14.3: Namo te kāsirājatthu, namo te kāsivaḍḍhana;
segments.ja506:14.5: Añjaliṃ te paggaṇhāmi, passeyyaṃ me nivesanaṃ.
segments.ja506:15.1: Addhā hi dubbissasametamāhu, yaṃ mānuso vissase amānusamhi;
segments.ja506:15.3: Sace ca maṃ yācasi etamatthaṃ, dakkhemu te nāga nivesanāni.
segments.ja506:16.1: Sacepi [sace hi (sī. pī. aṭṭha.)] vāto girimāvaheyya, cando ca suriyo ca chamā pateyyuṃ;
segments.ja506:16.3: Sabbā ca najjo paṭisotaṃ vajeyyuṃ, na tvevahaṃ rāja musā bhaṇeyyaṃ.
segments.ja506:17.1: Nabhaṃ phaleyya udadhīpi susse, saṃvaṭṭaye [saṃvaṭṭeyaṃ (sī. pī.), saṃvaṭṭeyya (syā. ka.)] bhūtadharā vasundharā;
segments.ja506:17.3: Siluccayo meru samūlamuppate [mubbahe (sī. syā. pī. ka. aṭṭha.), muṭṭhahe (ka.)], na tvevahaṃ rāja musā bhaṇeyyaṃ.
segments.ja506:18.1: Addhā hi dubbissasametamāhu, yaṃ mānuso vissase amānusamhi;
segments.ja506:18.3: Sace ca maṃ yācasi etamatthaṃ, dakkhemu te nāga nivesanāni.
segments.ja506:19.1: Tumhe khottha ghoravisā uḷārā, mahātejā khippakopī ca hotha;
segments.ja506:19.3: Maṃkāraṇā [mama kāraṇā (sī. syā. pī.)] bandhanasmā pamutto, arahasi no jānituye [jānitāye (sī.), jānitave (syā.), jānitaye (pī.)] katāni.
segments.ja506:20.1: So paccataṃ niraye ghorarūpe, mā kāyikaṃ sātamalattha kiñci;
segments.ja506:20.3: Peḷāya baddho maraṇaṃ upetu, yo tādisaṃ kammakataṃ na jāne.
segments.ja506:21.1: Saccappaṭiññā tavamesa hotu, akkodhano hohi anupanāhī;
segments.ja506:21.3: Sabbañca te nāgakulaṃ supaṇṇā, aggiṃva gimhesu [gimhāsu (sī. syā. pī.)] vivajjayantu.
segments.ja506:22.1: Anukampasī nāgakulaṃ janinda, mātā yathā suppiyaṃ ekaputtaṃ;
segments.ja506:22.3: Ahañca te nāgakulena saddhiṃ, kāhāmi veyyāvaṭikaṃ uḷāraṃ.
segments.ja506:23.1: Yojentu ve rājarathe sucitte, kambojake assatare sudante;
segments.ja506:23.3: Nāge ca yojentu suvaṇṇakappane, dakkhemu nāgassa nivesanāni.
segments.ja506:24.1: Bherī mudiṅgā [mutiṅgā (sī. pī.)] paṇavā ca saṅkhā, avajjayiṃsu uggasenassa rañño;
segments.ja506:24.3: Pāyāsi rājā bahusobhamāno, purakkhato nārigaṇassa majjhe.
segments.ja506:26.1: Sa rājā pāvisi byamhaṃ, campeyyassa nivesanaṃ;
segments.ja506:28.3: Dibbā tūriyā pavajjiṃsu, nāgakaññā ca naccisuṃ [naccayuṃ (sī. pī. ka.)].
segments.ja506:29.1: Taṃ nāgakaññā caritaṃ gaṇena, anvāruhī kāsirājā pasanno;
segments.ja506:30.1: So tattha bhutvā ca atho ramitvā, campeyyakaṃ kāsirājā avoca;
segments.ja506:30.5: Netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ [kimatthiyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja506:31.3: Paggayha pāyenti anomavaṇṇā, netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke;
segments.ja506:32.1: Najjo ca temā puthulomamacchā, āṭā [ādā (syā.), adā (pī.)] sakuntābhirudā sutitthā;
segments.ja506:32.3: Netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja506:33.1: Koñcā mayūrā diviyā ca haṃsā, vaggussarā kokilā sampatanti;
segments.ja506:33.3: Netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja506:34.1: Ambā ca sālā tilakā ca jambuyo, uddālakā pāṭaliyo ca phullā;
segments.ja506:34.3: Netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja506:35.1: Imā ca te pokkharañño samantato, dibbā [dibyā (syā.), diviyā (pī.)] ca gandhā satataṃ pavāyanti;
segments.ja506:35.3: Netādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ nāga tapo karosi.
segments.ja506:36.1: Na puttahetu na dhanassa hetu, na āyuno cāpi [vāpi (sī. pī.)] janinda hetu;
segments.ja506:36.3: Manussayoniṃ abhipatthayāno, tasmā parakkamma tapo karomi.
segments.ja506:38.3: Pucchāmi taṃ nāgarājetamatthaṃ, seyyo ito kena manussaloko.
segments.ja506:39.1: Janinda nāññatra manussalokā, suddhī va saṃvijjati saṃyamo vā;
segments.ja506:39.3: Ahañca laddhāna manussayoniṃ, kāhāmi jātimaraṇassa antaṃ.
segments.ja506:40.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja506:40.3: Nāriyo ca disvāna tuvañca nāga, kāhāmi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja506:41.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja506:41.3: Nāriyo ca disvāna mamañca rāja, karohi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja506:42.1: Idañca me jātarūpaṃ pahūtaṃ, rāsī suvaṇṇassa ca tālamattā;
segments.ja506:42.3: [ito haritvā sovaṇṇagharāni kāraya, rūpiyassa ca pākāraṃ karontu (sī. syā.) ito haritvā sovaṇṇagharāni,[kāraya] rūpiyassa ca pākāraṃ karontu (pī.)] Ito haritvāna suvaṇṇagharāni, karassu rūpiyapākāraṃ karontu [ito haritvā sovaṇṇagharāni kāraya, rūpiyassa ca pākāraṃ karontu (sī. syā.) ito haritvā sovaṇṇagharāni,[kāraya] rūpiyassa ca pākāraṃ karontu (pī.)].
segments.ja506:43.1: Muttā ca [muttānañca (sī. syā.)] vāhasahassāni pañca, veḷuriyamissāni ito haritvā;
segments.ja506:43.3: Antepure bhūmiyaṃ santharantu, nikkaddamā hehiti nīrajā ca.
segments.ja506:44.1: Etādisaṃ āvasa rājaseṭṭha, vimānaseṭṭhaṃ bahu sobhamānaṃ;
segments.ja506:44.3: Bārāṇasiṃ nagaraṃ iddhaṃ phītaṃ, rajjañca kārehi anomapaññāti.
